His son Chenghong was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangwu early in Kaiyuan, served as supernumerary Director of the Palace Library, and later as Director of the Imperial Clan.

Chengcai was enfeoffed as Prince of Dunhuang in 757 and given the rank of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Entitlement Equal to the Three Dukes.
承寀 is Chengcai, and 敦煌郡王 is the Prince of Dunhuang Commandery; 敦 is part of the place name.
When the Uyghurs rendered distinguished service, Chenbao received exceptional favor.
When the Uyghurs rendered distinguished service, Chengcai received exceptional favor.
That year he was installed as imperial great-grandson and a staff office was established.
That year he was installed as Imperial Heir Grandson and a staff office was established.
皇太孫 is the heir grandson of the reigning sovereign, not a great-grandson.
He was first enfeoffed as Prince of Tangchang, then transferred to Prince of Ping'en in the third year of Shenli.
He was first enfeoffed as Prince of Tangchang, then transferred to Prince of Ping'en in the third year of Shengli.
聖曆 is the Shengli era.
Some urged the princess to have Chongjun demoted to prince and make herself heir as "imperial great-daughter." Chongjun was consumed with hatred.
Some urged the princess to have Chongjun demoted to prince and make herself heir as "Imperial Heir Daughter." Chongjun was consumed with hatred.
皇太女 means an heir daughter, the female counterpart of 皇太子; no great-daughter is meant.
